# Account fixtures

Generated by `tools/scrubfixtures` from owner-provided captures, with one shared
identity map across all input files. Raw inputs remain outside the repository.

- `es_*`: Slurm 26.05.4 / data_parser v0.0.45; 16 user associations.
- `gfdl_*`: Slurm 26.05.2 / v0.0.45; empty association response.
- `ursa_*`: Slurm 25.11.8 / v0.0.44; empty association response.
- `shares_all.json`: four `CLUSTER:`-delimited documents from the multi-cluster
  capture. It deliberately is not a single JSON document.

Share rows are trimmed by the scrubber, retaining users and account ancestry.
Names, identifiers, lineage components, command arguments, and client paths are
anonymized. TRES resource names, numeric limits, versions, and enum values are
preserved. Partial failures and malformed responses are synthetic test cases.
